title: Source: src/error_catalog
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/error_catalog

src/error_catalog/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose the shared definition/occurrence API to runtime, Gateway and manual callers without importing those applications. Re-export immutable mapping types, registry lookups and resolver projections; installed JSON is loaded lazily by registry use. This facade owns no settings, storage or recovery action.

src/error_catalog/main.py

Python · Tier A

Print installed canonical diagnostics for launchers without application dependencies.

Responsibilities

Resolve a supplied static identity and bounded technical fact for command-line use.

Boundaries

No installation, retry, setting change, network access or runtime imports.

Lifecycle

Launchers invoke the module only on their existing failure path.

State

Reads the installed immutable catalog; never writes application state.

Security

Technical input is sanitized by the same mandatory occurrence boundary as HTTP.

Collaborators

Shell/PowerShell launchers and the package registry share canonical definitions.

Public surface

main accepts a reference, optional --technical text, and optional --json.

@see src/error_catalog/resolver.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
main 22 Emit one canonical error; malformed invocation is itself a catalog diagnostic.

src/error_catalog/audit.py

Python · Tier A

Discover production error producers and report unresolved source coverage without hiding gaps.

Responsibilities

Scan Python kinds, typed reasons, raises, API failures and browser failures.

Boundaries

Development tooling only; never runs on the normal error resolution path.

Lifecycle

Parse maintained source, resolve registered identities, apply explicit site annotations.

State

Deterministic source inventory records and counts; no mutable runtime registry writes.

Security

Source expressions only; never imports audited modules or reads runtime state.

Collaborators

Catalog registry supplies coverage; CI rejects unresolved product producers.

Public surface

audit_repository and scan_python support repository and fixture checks.

@see scripts/error_catalog_audit.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
literals 197 Extract direct and conditional string identities without evaluating source code.
scan_python 215 Inventory stable kinds, typed reason constructors, HTTP surfaces and all raise sites.
_PythonErrorScanner 224 @brief Index one Python file and collect diagnostic producers in traversal order. One scanner owns the indexes and output for one source file. Each detection method appends rows in the original breadth-first traversal order. The public scan_python facade keeps callers independent of this implementation.
_PythonErrorScanner._index_forwarders 248 @brief Find helper parameters that transport identities or catalog text keys. Record lexical owners so unrelated attribute calls cannot inherit these contracts.
_PythonErrorScanner._source_reference 360 @brief Resolve catalog provenance from syntax without trusting displayed message text. Follow known constructors, forwarding helpers and constants; stop reference cycles.
_PythonErrorScanner._bound_literals 499 Follow same-scope literal assignments conservatively without executing imports.
_PythonErrorScanner.scan 568 @brief Collect every applicable producer while preserving row order and multiplicity. Called once per source by scan_python; no inspected code is imported or executed.
_PythonErrorScanner._scan_return 612 @brief Inventory declared classifier results and literal tuple rejection reasons. Contract shapes select the identity-bearing member without evaluating the expression.
_PythonErrorScanner._scan_error_kind 728 @brief Retain literal, dynamic and propagated error-kind producers as separate rows. Absence and schema declarations remain visible with their existing classification.
_PythonErrorScanner._scan_call 844 @brief Inventory helper inputs, typed constructors, HTTP failures and raised calls. False preserves the typed-raise short circuit before the separate remediation scan.
scan_native 1069 Record explicit native failure calls while ignoring comments and quoted example code. Constructors and exits remain unresolved until a source review supplies their diagnostic identity or a justified non-user classification. No native toolchain or controller runtime is imported by this development-only scan.
audit_repository 1129 Resolve every discovered stable producer or leave it explicitly unresolved in the report.

src/error_catalog/compatibility.py

Python · Tier A · Compatibility / retirement boundary

Keep legacy USER_MESSAGES, LLM_MESSAGES and TEXT consumers tied to one installed catalog. Dictionary/template projections preserve historic tuple order and source keys; CatalogText carries identity through existing exception strings. source_message renders bounded primitive values without discarding required whitespace. Bootstrap projections keep older callers usable when catalog data is unavailable; execution decisions remain caller-owned.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
CatalogText 46 Attach a stable source reference and copied diagnostic-facts dictionary to a string so existing exception constructors and left/right concatenation retain provenance. This carrier does not itself validate or sanitize arbitrary text; canonical rendering and public projection own those steps.
source_template 62 Project an old TEXT template from its canonical definition without a copy table.
legacy_template 71 Resolve a historical template without blocking application startup on catalog damage.
source_templates 79 Project all registered source diagnostics for legacy TEXT dictionary callers.
source_message 96 Render a registered source template using validated catalog formatting and bounded primitive substitutions, preserving intentional whitespace and returning CatalogText provenance. Private declarations redact their values; the timezone template alone adds its reviewed scalar fact. Unknown references return None, while caught lookup failures use bootstrap copy.
messages 135 Return legacy tuples for the requested historical copy group.
aliases 153 Return registered legacy aliases of USER entries without a parallel alias dictionary.

src/error_catalog/http_boundary.py

Python · Tier A

Add canonical error presentation at Agent, Gateway and manual HTTP boundaries while preserving status and execution evidence. enrich_failure handles diagnostic fields; middleware examines bounded complete JSON responses; install registers exception handlers and optional cached definition/lookup/browser-subset routes. Successful target HTTP receipts remain intact. This module neither sanitizes every business payload nor supplies authentication or recovery authority.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
public_definition 48 Expose static presentation fields without internal adapter or compatibility metadata.
client_script 63 Generate the public browser catalog for serving and payload-size audits.
enrich_failure 108 Copy an explicit failure envelope and sanitize its diagnostic fields while retaining business data, status facts and legacy shape. Reproject an existing canonical occurrence or resolve the supplied cause with a registered HTTP-status fallback. This is diagnostic enrichment, not whole- response sanitization or a decision to retry.
http_failure 163 Keep receipt cause/facts across an HTTP wrapper without changing its legacy detail.
ErrorResponseMiddleware 217 Enrich bounded JSON error responses emitted directly by auth/admission middleware.
ErrorResponseMiddleware.__call__ 228 Inspect only a complete single JSON body at most 256 KiB after its response start. Enrich HTTP errors or explicit failure payloads, except target HTTP observation receipts carried by a successful outer response. Forward streamed, oversized, invalid JSON and non-HTTP traffic unchanged. Preserve status and unrelated headers; replace length and remove stale MD5/ETag when the body changes.
install 322 Register shared HTTP, request-validation and unexpected-error handlers plus bounded response enrichment. Optional catalog routes serve static definitions, a generated browser subset and exact reference lookup. Import FastAPI/Starlette only at installation; callers still own application authentication and route access.
install.client_catalog 390 Serve the generated UI validation subset without occurrence or private data.
install.catalog 408 Serve all public static definitions with an ETag combining catalog version and content fingerprint. An exact If-None-Match returns 304; unavailable catalog data returns a 503 bootstrap diagnostic.
install.lookup 432 Resolve a registered ID, GUID, slug or alias to public static fields, including manual/settings navigation. An unknown reference returns a canonical 404, and unavailable installed definitions return 503.

src/error_catalog/manual_projection.py

Python · Tier A

Generate searchable deep error documentation from the installed canonical catalog.

Responsibilities

Produce one index and one rich Manual page per immutable Error ID.

Boundaries

No Manual application import, repository scan, network or occurrence lookup.

Lifecycle

Manual corpus construction consumes deterministic page dictionaries.

State

Reads immutable definitions; generated pages are detached projections.

Security

Only static catalog knowledge is published, never occurrence values or secrets.

Collaborators

manual.documents consumes pages; registry resolves related error identities.

Public surface

generate_error_pages returns stable document IDs and Markdown bodies.

@see src/manual/documents.py

@see src/error_catalog/error_msg.json

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
generate_error_pages 28 Generate a static index and one detached page per allocated Error ID, including retired entries, replacement links, aliases and remedy/verification sections. Read installed definitions only, with no occurrence lookup. Catalog failure yields one bootstrap help page instead of recursively resolving every definition.

src/error_catalog/models.py

Python · Tier A

Provide detached immutable JSON carriers for canonical error definitions and individual occurrences. freeze and thaw convert mappings/arrays between read-only records and caller-owned projections; ErrorDefinition supports mapping and attribute lookup. These types freeze supplied data but do not validate definitions or redact secrets: schema, registry and resolver own those boundaries.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
freeze 29 Detach nested JSON mappings into read-only mapping proxies and arrays into tuples. Scalar leaves are retained as supplied; this utility neither validates the catalog nor sanitizes occurrence content, so those boundaries must run before construction.
thaw 38 Produce a detached JSON-compatible value from a frozen record.
ErrorDefinition 48 Read-only catalog record with attribute access and detached JSON export.
ErrorDefinition.as_dict 71 Return detached JSON data; callers cannot mutate the registry.
ErrorEnvelope 80 Carry an occurrence as the same detached, immutable JSON mapping used for definitions. Constructing this dataclass only freezes data; resolve_error owns identity selection, redaction and bounded public fields.

src/error_catalog/recovery.py

Python · Tier A

Registered recovery navigation and guidance; component owners retain execution authority.

Details

Only these identifiers can become browser actions. Diagnostic text never supplies an endpoint, command or permission. Occurrence projection does not probe or mutate services.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
action 57 Return a detached allowlisted descriptor; roles affect display, never authorization.
projection 66 Offer evidence-compatible guidance without inferring success or retry authority.
for_role 123 Recompute actions from canonical cause; never trust retained action descriptors.

src/error_catalog/redaction.py

Python · Tier A

Sanitize diagnostic facts before they reach public error surfaces, independently of optional application redaction. secret_values gathers bounded explicit credentials and encoded variants from supplied data; safe_text removes known values and credential patterns; sanitize detaches JSON-like structures with traversal limits. No secret store is read, and original execution evidence stays with its owner.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
secret_values 60 Collect explicit credential-bearing strings from supplied data with depth, node, collection and count limits; include URL-encoded and JSON-escaped variants. Inspect no store or provider. Known values let later sanitization remove unlabelled echoes as well as recognizable credential patterns.
sensitive_key 96 Recognize secret-bearing fields without suppressing safe token-count facts.
safe_text 106 Accept primitive text or an exception string argument without invoking arbitrary object formatting. Replace supplied secret values before credential-pattern redaction and final truncation, overscanning enough to hide a secret that straddles the visible boundary. This bounded diagnostic projection does not rewrite source receipts.
sanitize 137 Detach JSON-compatible facts under shared string/node budgets and per-container/depth limits. Redact sensitive-key values, sanitize text, represent cycles/unsupported objects with markers and map nonfinite floats to null. Preserve ordinary integers/booleans; these traversal limits are not a promised serialized-byte ceiling.

src/error_catalog/registry.py

Python · Tier A

Load and validate the installed error_msg.json once, then share immutable definitions and exact GUID/ID/slug/alias indexes under a process-local cache and lock. Lookup helpers serve runtime and generated manual consumers; version and raw-content fingerprint support HTTP caching. Failed loads are cached to avoid recursive file reads; public projection boundaries provide bootstrap diagnostics.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
registry 71 Publish immutable indexes once, caching installation failure to prevent recursive I/O.
get_error_details 81 Resolve GUID, ID, slug or registered alias; unknown references raise KeyError.
error_exists 88 Test exact registration without treating arbitrary text as a new alias.
iter_error_definitions 98 Iterate immutable definitions in committed allocation order.
catalog_version 103 Return the installed catalog content version.
catalog_fingerprint 108 Return the cached installed content hash, invalidating clients when copy changes.
manual_doc_id 113 Derive the permanent Manual document identity from the immutable Error ID.

src/error_catalog/remediation.py

Python · Tier A

Validate semantic error setting links against a supplied real settings registry.

Responsibilities

Reject stale sections, setting keys, model parameters and component targets.

Boundaries

Does not import or initialize runtime settings and never changes values.

Lifecycle

Build/test and explicit settings diagnostics supply the current registry payload.

State

No mutable shared state.

Security

References contain semantic identifiers only, never values or DOM selectors.

Collaborators

Mission Control registry and canonical definitions own their respective data.

Public surface

validate_setting_references returns every broken catalog target.

@see src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/settings.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
current_setting_reference 19 Resolve retained catalog links to the current Model routing section. Model connection and generation fields now belong to role editors rather than flat registry controls. Navigate to their owning section without inventing a focus target or changing the catalog's retained guidance.
validate_setting_references 46 Check all catalog settings against actual section-owned controls and parameters.

src/error_catalog/renderer.py

Python · Tier A

Turn catalog definitions and supported occurrence facts into human guidance, legacy Markdown and semantic settings links. interpolate accepts only declared public primitive placeholders; legacy_copy and occurrence_presentation preserve certainty and measured/estimated distinctions. message_markdown fences technical text and settings_actions maps retained targets to current sections. These are pure presentation operations and do not change settings or execution truth.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
interpolate 33 Replace only simple named placeholders whose declared public type matches a supplied primitive. Missing/private/invalid values become unavailable; numbers must be finite and within the exact JSON integer range. Sanitize nonnumeric substitutions and bound the final presentation to 4,000 characters without evaluating formatting expressions.
finite_number 56 Accept bounded JSON numbers, excluding booleans and nonfinite measurements.
public_timezone 65 Permit only a short zone-shaped identifier, never arbitrary source prose.
gateway_not_dispatched 80 Require explicit connection-boundary proof, never infer from error prose.
legacy_copy 96 Derive compatibility observation/fix strings from canonical templates and validated facts. Specialize proven pre-dispatch connection failures, measured model timeout/output limits and rejected decisions; suggestions are descriptive and do not change settings, receipts or retry permission.
occurrence_presentation 143 Build everyday guidance and observed/next-step text from recognized timezone, provider-status, timeout and measured/estimated context facts. Require explicit connection/nonexecution proof for the Gateway no-dispatch variant. The resolver applies unknown-effect precedence afterward; raw legacy prose is not treated as measured evidence.
message_markdown 264 Render the canonical presentation and guidance for legacy Markdown/notification consumers, appending bounded technical text and occurrence references. Choose a fence longer than any embedded backtick run so technical text stays fenced; callers own prior sanitization.
settings_actions 309 Project only catalog setting steps into navigation metadata, retaining label and applies_to scope. Map retained model controls through current_setting_reference; the result contains no command to save or execute a change.

src/error_catalog/resolver.py

Python · Tier A

Connect structured producer causes to stable catalog identities and bounded public occurrence envelopes. fields and resolve_error_ref preserve typed/source precedence; resolve_error combines static guidance with sanitized facts and unknown-effect cautions. project_error_detail refreshes historical presentation while retaining occurrence identity when available. Bootstrap diagnostics avoid catalog recursion; no receipt, retry decision or persisted state is changed.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
source_facts 73 Retain reviewed source variables through CatalogText without parsing prose.
fields 90 Extract supported identity and fact carriers from mappings, typed exceptions and CatalogText without importing producers. Bound exception-cause traversal to eight identities; Pydantic causes omit rejected inputs. This is an internal extraction step, not a sanitized public payload.
resolve_error_ref 189 Resolve exact canonical identities first, then explicit/source references, typed subsystem reasons and recognized causal protocol facts before broad aliases, exception ancestry and fallback. Bound cyclic causes and return the reserved internal identity for unknown causes. Provider prose is not parsed here; the runtime compatibility facade owns its limited final text fallback.
bootstrap_envelope 353 Construct an independent catalog-unavailable occurrence using fixed copy and a fresh UUID when normal resolution cannot load usable definitions. Sanitize the stage, omit technical input and avoid any registry lookup so reporting catalog damage cannot recurse.
resolve_error 432 Combine a canonical definition with sanitized metadata, supplied runtime facts and bounded technical detail. Generate or preserve an occurrence ID and project settings/manual guidance without changing execution state. Unknown-effect facts replace remediation/presentation while retaining the causal identity. Listed catalog/data failures return the independent bootstrap envelope.
project_error_detail 588 Rebuild presentation for retained diagnostics without modifying saved input. Preserve an existing occurrence ID, or derive a UUID5 from the supplied historical key, resolved identity and stage. Recorded allowlisted facts override supplemental facts; without a retained identity/key, ordinary resolution can create a fresh occurrence.

src/error_catalog/schema.py

Python · Tier A

Reject malformed installed catalog data before registry publication. validate_catalog checks field sets, canonical unique identities/aliases, guidance/remedy contracts, template declarations and acyclic canonical relations, returning the validated input mapping. This structural validation does not establish that a remedy matches its producer or that a settings target exists; review evidence and remediation validation provide those separate checks.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
require 59 Reject a corrupt built-in catalog at load and build time.
nonempty 65 Accept meaningful strings, excluding empty or placeholder catalog content.
choice 70 Validate enum shape before membership, including malformed unhashable JSON values.
validate_catalog 80 Validate the installed catalog as a whole before it becomes available: strict field sets, canonical unique identities/aliases, meaningful guidance, remedy/scope shapes, declared safe template variables and resolvable relations. Reject replacement cycles and changes to reserved identities. Return the original validated mapping; freezing, source-evidence review and checking real settings targets belong to other owners.

src/error_catalog/startup.py

Python · Tier A

Project startup failures without echoing configuration inputs.

Responsibilities

  • Map known catalog identities, concrete OS failures and scoped validation facts into startup occurrences.

Boundaries

  • Bootstrap projection does not change error identities, configuration defaults or application startup policy.

Lifecycle

  • Classify the caught failure, extract safe configuration locations and return the existing catalog envelope.

State

  • There is no worker or persistent state; input exceptions stay owned by the failing startup path.

Security

  • Never include raw configuration input or arbitrary private exception text in the public projection.

Collaborators

  • error_catalog resolution supplies envelopes; startup callers supply the failed stage.

Public surface

  • startup_error returns catalog occurrence facts; StartupTLSFailure identifies pre-bind HTTPS identity failures.

@see src/error_catalog/init.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
StartupTLSFailure 34 The launcher failed while preparing its HTTPS identity, before HTTP bind.
startup_error 44 Prefer registered source identity, then bounded configuration issues, TLS/OS failures and runtime-state exception ownership. Clear technical detail, metadata and runtime facts for the pre-authentication bootstrap status surface; never reflect arbitrary configuration inputs. Return a diagnostic without changing startup decisions.
configuration_issues 99 Expose at most 20 validation issues as allowlisted field-name prefixes and fixed type/range requirements. Stop field traversal at an unrecognized component and omit rejected input, provider prose and URLs.

src/error_catalog/tool_diagnostics.py

Python · Tier A

Preserve canonical causes as failed tool receipts move between full and compact views. tool_error_detail selects established cause fields and stable occurrence identity, compact_tool_error retains a small protected diagnostic, and retain_cause refines adapter guidance without changing wire status/effect facts. Success receipts pass through; arbitrary tool output is not searched for error identities.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
tool_error_detail 42 Project only recognized failed receipt statuses. Merge approved cause fields from data, caller metadata, existing detail and the outer receipt in that precedence order; retain an occurrence ID or derive one from operation identity. Collect known private values before resolution. Successful and nonmapping receipts return None.
compact_tool_error 81 Small canonical diagnosis protected from optional tool-output clipping.
retain_cause 102 Refine a known adapter cause by adding its canonical Error ID and updating only existing human guidance fields on a shallow receipt copy. Preserve wire kind and execution facts; unknown causes return the original receipt unchanged.
